title: CASSANDRA-20829 Notify secondary indexes about rows in fully expired SSTables
notes: Head is the landed cassandra-4.0 commit (PR #4313's own head is d9bcf8119f86). All issues are hard: they come from CASSANDRA-21577 (created 2026-08-14) and fix PR #5027. K3 has its fix in NoOpIndex, PaxosUncommittedIndex and RouteJournalIndex, which this diff does not touch; the root cause is the default in Index.java. Severity of K1 and K2 is from the research; K3 minor likewise. Training contamination: the fix and the follow-up ticket post-date the case head, but a model may still have seen them. Recheck per model before trusting a recall number. CASSANDRA-20829 is the same ticket as B5, at its landed state rather than review time.

known_issues.summary: maybeNotifyIndexersAboutRowsInFullyExpiredSSTables has no catch: a read error or throwing indexer aborts compaction and the expired SSTables are never obsoleted
Only rows from partition.next() reach indexer.removeRow; the static row is never delivered
notifyIndexerAboutRowsInFullyExpiredSSTables defaults to true; indexes that do not need it (NoOpIndex, PaxosUncommittedIndex, RouteJournalIndex) force pointless scans
